profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with no setup required. Its site also promotes a feature called Intelligent Model Routing, which it claims delivers the same quality output at 65% lower average cost than the previous version of its Max Mode offering.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as a coding and developer tool with an agentic coding capability. The held facts note a source-code exposure concern associated with this product. Replit also has a presence in the MCP registry through a server described as offering free buyer-side outcome verification and provider comparison for supplied agent receipts.

The site's held facts record 175 points of legal exposure tied to California, though no specific cases are listed in the available data.
